title: SONA Vibe Check
subtitle: 7 quick picks so we know what spins in your world before you join.

questions.question: It's 11:30 PM and the rain just started hitting the window. What's on?

options.label: Moody synth-pop & nocturnal electronic
Fuzzy indie rock & nostalgic shoegaze
Warm Rhodes jazz, neo-soul, or lo-fi beats
Heavy basslines, UK garage, or club edits

questions.question: Dream 1 AM late-night food order — no budget, no regrets:

options.label: Steaming tonkotsu ramen with extra jammy egg
Crispy corner-shop pepperoni slice, folded in half
Chili-oil dumplings & cold sesame noodles
Warm butter croissant & herbal tea (civilized chaos)

questions.question: How are you getting across town on a Saturday afternoon?

options.label: Window seat on the train, headphones glued on
Biking fast through backstreets with one earbud in
Aimless iced-coffee walk past vintage shops
Windows down, aux cord strictly mine

questions.question: You're picking one type of playlist you can't live without:

options.label: Rare B-sides, tape demos & 2,000-play SoundCloud gems
Sun-drenched indie pop, funk & feel-good grooves
Ambient piano, vinyl jazz & instrumental textures
High-tempo club tools, breakbeats & warehouse cuts

questions.question: If you could only eat ONE snack forever while digging through crates:

options.label: Salted sourdough pretzels & dark chocolate
Extra-spicy kettle chips or chili mango
Fresh berries & iced matcha
Spicy tuna onigiri from a tiny corner market

questions.question: Sunday morning with zero alarms — what's the move?

options.label: Watering plants, pour-over coffee, spinning a full LP
Developing 35mm film & reorganizing saved tracks
Morning run followed by rooftop brunch with friends
Still recovering from last night's 2 AM DJ set

questions.question: Which sound instantly gives you goosebumps in any track?

options.label: Detuned analog synths & reverb-soaked vocals
Crisp breakbeats, sub-bass & chopped vocal samples
Warm horn sections, upright bass & vinyl crackle
Shimmering jangly guitars & upbeat basslines
